metric: per-run stage sum, then median; query is wall time

variants.drop: End local aggregate state destruction on the CPU worker
variants.coalesce: maximum 16 immediately ready input batches per job instead of 128

sampling: macOS sample, 6 seconds, 1 ms interval, original uninstrumented release binaries; top-of-stack counts restricted to coordinator sink finish call trees
notes: No builds, correctness tests, or samplers run concurrently with traced timings.
Stage durations include nested work; never sum a parent and its children.
Independent pipelines overlap; sums across pipelines are not a query critical path.
before aggregate finish includes partial export/partition jobs; after export is timed separately as pipeline.local_finish_wall.
before Window is implemented through BufferSinkExec; after has WindowSinkExec.
Diagnostic timers and logging perturb timings; use phase values for attribution and separate uninstrumented runs for overall comparisons.
The before q67 intermediate ROLLUP has 501983 rows vs after 501976: the old 8-way empty grouping set emits 7 extra empty groups. Final q67 top-100 agrees in the validation runs.
validation: drop/coalesce/both x q51/q67 x ZeroCompile/Compile = 12/12 passed vs DataFusion; performance sampling/trace runs use --profile and do not validate
